policy.threshold_policy: No threshold, weight, suffix list, corpus string, or domain dictionary is a Canon default. Those values must come from explicit profile or strategy configuration and be reported in artifact hashes.

roles.description: Disabling this family should create a true-pair miss or a false-pair admission.
This family creates attractive evidence for a false pair that must be rejected or sent to review.
This family contributes no evidence and the system must not fabricate support.
Duplicate evidence from this family must be deduplicated before scoring.
Support and contradiction from this family must both survive explanation and scoring.

cases.purpose: Exact alias evidence is necessary for one planted same-entity pair but must not override planted distinct labels.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: necessary true pair is missed; misleading false pair should no longer have this evidence family as support
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: misleading and contradictory false pairs reject or review rather than auto-link

cases.purpose: Generic normalization can recover surface variation without introducing corpus-specific rewrites.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: necessary true pair is missed at normalization or retrieval
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: normalized-name-only misleading pairs reject or review

cases.purpose: Similarity evidence can admit useful near names but cannot become an unchecked merge rule.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: near-name true pair drops from candidate coverage
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: high-similarity false pair rejects or reviews

cases.purpose: Sparse retrieval admits candidates that exact or local similarity alone may miss.
Trusted identifiers are strong only when namespace trust is explicit.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: trusted-id true pair requires weaker evidence or review
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: untrusted or contradictory anchor cannot force a merge

cases.purpose: Address and web-domain anchors support candidates but shared locations and domains remain false-merge risks.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: anchor-only true pair drops to review or miss
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: shared address or shared domain false pair rejects or reviews

cases.purpose: Contextual co-occurrence helps repeated weak surfaces but does not replace direct entity evidence.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: context-dependent true pair loses supporting context
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: co-occurrence-only false pair rejects or reviews

cases.purpose: Source priors calibrate evidence reliability but cannot force identity.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: calibration-sensitive true pair may fall to review
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: prior-only false pair rejects or reviews

cases.purpose: Relationship edges improve explanation and review but are never same-entity evidence by themselves.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: relationship explanations and cannot-link support disappear
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: no relationship-only pair may auto-link or cluster-merge

cases.purpose: The union run exposes marginal family effects without hiding individual failures.

expected_by_ablation.without_family_under_test: not applicable; union is the comparison baseline
expected_by_ablation.with_family_only: union report must expose per-family marginal results instead of one opaque score
